needed.evidence: informal path with no usable width
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk of at least 1.5 metres width along the right side of the street.
Remove parked vehicles and other obstructions cluttering the left sidewalk to ensure full accessibility.
Repair uneven sections of the sidewalk to eliminate tripping hazards for pedestrians.
Pave and level the informal path on the right side to prevent tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: zebra crossing obstructed and not properly signalized
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the pedestrian crossing to include signalisation and ensure it is clearly visible and unobstructed.

needed.evidence: pedestrians crossing in the carriageway despite zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Implement signal lights and a refuge island at the crossing to improve pedestrian safety and reduce the risk of collisions.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to allow smooth and safe access for pedestrians, particularly those with mobility issues.
